title: Ollabench: Evaluating LLMs’ Reasoning for Human-centric Interdependent Cybersecurity
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects related to faith or religion. The OllaBench framework assesses LLMs' accuracy, wastefulness, and consistency in answering scenario-based information security compliance and non-compliance questions, based on cognitive behavioral theories.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its focus is on evaluating LLM reasoning for human-centric interdependent cybersecurity.
